title: Complete Guest Checkout Flow

sections.name: Checkout
items: After adding an item, Brava now opens the cart and selects Guest Checkout.
Shipping and payment details are filled from the assigned profile on their correct pages.
Brava continues through shipping, payment, review, and Place Order in sequence.

sections.name: CAPTCHA
items: Checkout pauses only when a CAPTCHA is actually present and resumes from the interrupted step.

instructions: Open Brava, go to Settings, check for updates, then select Update & restart.
